comment: No source is published. The figures 20Hz, 14.5kHz and 8% are the maker's own: they are printed in the parameter tooltips the census carries. They are attributed to the maker in the lines because they describe the modelled hardware's behaviour rather than anything measured here. The filter is skipped entirely when neither V/OCT nor INPUT is patched and the resonance parameter is at or below 4, which is how a self-oscillating filter keeps running with nothing patched to it while an idle one costs nothing.
